To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the AUG-stop sequence induces boron (B)–dependent ribosome stalling and mRNA degradation.
the minimum uORFs, which we refer to as AUG-stops, play a role in B-dependent regulation of gene expression in Arabidopsis.
the minimum upstream open reading frame, AUG-stop, regulates boron-responsive genes through ribosome staling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism by which the AUG-stop regulates gene expression in response to B and identifies a new role for AUG-stop in regulating gene expression in eukaryotic cells.
the mechanism of B-dependent gene regulation, which is mediated by AUG-stop.
a mechanism for B-dependent gene regulation, in which B-dependent ribosome stall at AUG-stop induces the suppression of translation, followed by mRNA degradation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
AUG-stop plays a critical role in the B-dependent regulation of plant genes, including Nip5;1, SKU5, and ABS/NGAL.

AUG-stop, which is present in many eukaryotic genes, plays an important role as an mRNA regulatory sequence by inducing ribosome stalling, and thus, mRNA degradation, and by regulating translation initiation in a condition-dependent and organism-specific manner.
AUG-stop is a common regulatory element that regulates the expression of B-responsive genes through ribosome stailing and mRNA degradation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the minimum uORFs, AUG-stops, are involved in the regulation of mRNA accumulation in eukaryotic cells, including plants, and that this regulation is dependent on environmental conditions.
the AUG-stop in the 5'UTR of the B-responsive genes is a cis-regulatory element for B-dependent regulation of the gene expression.
B-dependent ribosome stall occurs at AUG-stop and induces mRNA decay in a manner dependent on the conserved sequence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a minimum uORF in the 5’UTR of a plant gene, which is translated ahead of the downstream ORF, plays a role in regulating the translation and stability of mRNAs in response to B availability.
AUG-stop plays a role in B-dependent gene regulation, and the B-responsive AUG-stops identified here are conserved in other species, including humans.
the minimum open reading frame, AUG-Stop (uORF), plays a critical role in boron-dependent regulation of mRNA accumulation.
